data.long_meaning: From the Old German words ‘fah’ meaning ‘to hold’ and ‘sal’ meaning ‘salvation’. The name Fassold can be translated as ‘one who holds fast to salvation’ or ‘faithful one’. This name has been historically used in Europe and is popular among Christians. The name Fassold carries the meaning “Hold fast, faithful” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Fassold usually hope their child will grow to embody hold fast, faithful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
